summary: Russian forces conducted group strikes against port infrastructure in Chornomorsk, Odessa Oblast, targeting Ukrainian cargo storage facilities. Widespread drone activity was reported across multiple regions, including attacks on Moscow and a refinery in Stavropol Krai. Significant political shifts occurred in Ukraine with the announced resignation of Prime Minister Sviridenko.
key_points: Russian forces conducted group strikes against port infrastructure in Chornomorsk, Odessa Oblast, specifically targeting facilities used for storing Ukrainian cargo (Source: @tass_agency/385003).
A drone attack in Stavropol Krai caused a fire at an oil refinery in the industrial zone of Vyazniki (Source: @UkraineNow/82608).
Russian forces reported striking a group of Ukrainian UAV operators in the Sumy region (Source: @tass_agency/385011).
Drones attacked Moscow and a refinery in Stavropol Krai, resulting in three deaths and five injuries in the Moscow region (Source: @UkraineNow/82608, @tass_agency/385001).
A Russian drone struck a gas station and a fuel tanker in Slavyansk (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31569).
The Russian Armed Forces attacked a gas station in Slavyansk (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31560).
Russian forces reported an unsuccessful Ukrainian counterattack near the village of Pryshyb east of Sviatohirsk, Donetsk People's Republic (Source: @tass_agency/385012).
Russian forces reported that Ukrainian forces continue to hide in basements in the north and northwest of Kostiantynivka, Donetsk People's Republic (Source: @tass_agency/385012).
